_about: The aerial, FPV, insect-scale and planet-scale move table (references/aerial-and-fpv.md). The owner chose all four packages of the aerial and FPV proposal of 2026-10-26 [studio history]. Every range is a practitioner default or a measured animal figure, not physics: blocking.py warns outside a range and refuses only a cap (max_turns). prompt_lint.py (through aerial_qa.lint_aerial) reads the same table for the `aerial:` declaration on a clip prompt. The `dji` block maps DJI's in-app presets (QuickShots, MasterShots, FocusTrack, Hyperlapse, Waypoint Flight, Cruise Control, Easy ACRO) onto these moves for the pilot sheet (flyover.py pilot).
_units: metres, metres per second, seconds, degrees. Practitioner figures were given in mph and ft: 1 mph = 0.447 m/s, 1 ft = 0.305 m, rounded to one decimal.

_sources.droneu: Drone U, '14 Types of Shots in Drone Cinematography' [PRACTITIONER, read 2026-10-26]
_sources.premiumbeat: PremiumBeat, '8 flight tips for drone footage' [PRACTITIONER]
_sources.hejazi2022: Hejazi, Kuchler, Bagheri & Bodenschatz 2022, 'Flight of a honeybee in turbulent wind', arXiv 2209.05977 [PRIMARY]
_sources.iams2012: Iams 2012, 'Free flight of the mosquito Aedes aegypti', arXiv 1205.5260 [PRIMARY]
_sources.eames1977: Powers of Ten (Charles and Ray Eames, 1977) [FILM]
_sources.esa_iss: ESA, 'Flying over Earth' (ISS: 400 km, 28,800 km/h, 90-minute orbit) [PRIMARY]
_sources.segmind_hf: Segmind on the Higgsfield Earth Zoom Out preset (3 or 5 s; distortion when the ground-to-orbit step is rushed) [VENDOR]
_sources.dji_mini4pro: DJI Mini 4 Pro User Manual v1.0, 2023.09 (FocusTrack p27-31, MasterShots p34, QuickShots p35-36, Hyperlapse p37, Waypoint Flight p40, Cruise Control p45, specifications) [PRIMARY]
_sources.dji_mini5pro: DJI Mini 5 Pro User Manual v1.0, 2025.09 (4.1-4.5) [PRIMARY]
_sources.dji_mavic4pro: DJI Mavic 4 Pro User Manual v1.2, 2025.09 (4.1 ActiveTrack ranges; gimbal specifications) [PRIMARY]
_sources.dji_neo: DJI Neo User Manual v1.2, 2024.11 (Switching Modes: Follow, Dronie, Circle, Rocket, Spotlight, DirectionTrack, Helix, Boomerang) [PRIMARY]
_sources.dji_avata2: DJI Avata 2 User Manual v1.0 (Easy ACRO; specifications) [PRIMARY]
_sources.mastershots_list: studiosport.fr Air 2S MasterShots guide (ten manoeuvres) and heliguy 'How to use MasterShots on DJI Mini 4 Pro' (Proximity moves); DJI's manuals do not list the sequence [SECONDARY]

functions.establish: where we are — the world before the scene
functions.scale: how big the place or the thing is
functions.isolation: a figure small and alone in the landscape
functions.vulnerability: someone tracked or watched from above
functions.geography: how the place is laid out (a hole, a lot, a route); the plan view is information
functions.pattern: a shape only visible from above
functions.reveal: the move uncovers what the scene is about
functions.ending: the pull away that closes the film
functions.judgment: the god's-eye view that weighs what happened
functions.breathing: a cut away from an intimate scene that gives the viewer room
functions.journey: the route itself carries the story (a one-take, a flight, a crossing)

drone.words: from a drone, smooth and unhurried

fpv.words: on an FPV drone, banking into its turns

cinewhoop.words: on a small ducted cinewhoop, gliding through the space a few feet above the floor

insect.words: at an insect's scale, a hand-width above the ground, real time

planet.words: a continuous move between ground and orbit

orbit.source: droneu: 3-5 mph, radius 50-150 ft, never more than 1.5 orbits in a delivered edit

helix.words: rising slowly in a spiral around {subject}, one turn every ten seconds
helix.source: droneu: one circle per 8-12 s; no more than three, two is usually plenty

flyover.words: flying low and level toward {subject}, climbing only at the last moment
flyover.source: droneu: 8-15 mph approach; 'climbing too early removes the tension'

fly_through.words: threading slowly through the gap in {subject}

tilt_down_reveal.words: flying out over the edge as the camera tilts down to reveal {subject}
tilt_down_reveal.source: droneu: 5-10 mph, gimbal tilting down as the drone crosses an edge

pull_back_reveal.words: pulling back and rising away from {subject} until the place is the subject
pull_back_reveal.source: droneu: 4-8 mph straight, optional slow climb; endings, isolation, scale

top_down.words: looking straight down on {subject}, drifting slowly

parallax_orbit.words: arcing slowly round {subject} past a near foreground that slides across the frame
parallax_orbit.source: droneu: 3-4 mph, foreground 10-20 ft from the drone

pedestal.words: rising straight up the face of {subject}, the camera level
pedestal.source: droneu: climb at 3-6 mph, held constant, camera level

rocket.words: rising straight up over {subject}, looking straight down as the ground falls away
rocket.source: dji_mini4pro p35: 'ascends with the camera pointing downward' (the Neo keeps the camera on the subject instead); climb rate as the pedestal (droneu); Cine mode caps the ascent at 3 m/s

boomerang.words: swinging round {subject} on a wide oval, rising as it swings away and sinking as it comes back
boomerang.source: dji_mini4pro p35: oval, ascending away from the start and descending back; the start is one end of the long axis, the far end is across the subject; clear 30 m radius and 10 m above

little_planet.words: opening on a little-planet view of {subject} curled into a sphere, unrolling into the real view as the camera descends
little_planet.source: dji_mini4pro p36 (Asteroid): flies back and up, stitches a panorama, and the video opens on it before the descent; clear 40 m behind and 50 m above. A stitched effect, not a camera move: an opener only

hyperlapse.words: a slow drifting time-lapse over {subject}, clouds and traffic streaming while the camera glides
hyperlapse.source: dji_mini4pro p37: Free, Circle, Course Lock, Waypoint; recommended above 50 m with a static subject more than 15 m away; 25 photos make one second. The top of the range is the usual 120 m (400 ft) ceiling as the top-down move

side_follow.words: keeping pace alongside {subject} at a fixed distance
side_follow.source: droneu: 20-60 ft to the side; closer feels more urgent

push_in.words: pushing in slowly toward {subject}, stopping before it fills the frame
push_in.source: droneu: 2-4 mph straight, constant, stop before the subject fills the frame

hover_pan.words: hovering still while the camera pans slowly across {subject}

hole_flyover.words: lifting off the tee, climbing late along the strategy line over the hazards, descending to the green
hole_flyover.source: Drone U golf: off the tee, climbs as it travels, descends as it nears the hole — 'the hole from the ball's perspective'; speed as the fly-over approach

fpv_chase.words: chasing {subject} as a second flyer, banking where it turns

fpv_dive.words: diving from altitude into the chase

cinewhoop_oner.words: one continuous flight through {subject}, scene after scene in story order
cinewhoop_oner.source: Drone U 2022 (one take, scenes in order); speed range [assumed] — no source gives one

bee.words: a bee's flight: easing forward, stopping sharply into tight turns a hand-width wide
bee.source: hejazi2022: mean 0.71 m/s near the hive; 'accelerate slowly and decelerate rapidly'; turn radius 12.7-21.9 cm. The speed range around the mean is [assumed]

mosquito.words: a mosquito's flight: slipping sideways and backwards, the view rarely pointing where it travels
mosquito.source: iams2012: heading rarely matches travel; turns of 50-200 degrees; sideslip 0.3-1 g; speeds under 0.4 m/s in a small chamber (a limit of the set-up). The speed range is [assumed]

earth_zoom.words: a continuous plunge from orbit through the cloud layer to {subject}
earth_zoom.source: segmind_hf: 3 or 5 s; distortion when the ground-to-orbit step is rushed; eames1977 for pace. max_decades_per_s [assumed]

pull_back_planet.words: pulling back from {subject} through the clouds until the whole Earth hangs in black
pull_back_planet.source: Contact (1997): the pull-back, reversed from a fly-in because forward 'seemed false'; eames1977

orbital_drift.words: drifting over the Earth at orbital height, the coastline sliding past below

continent_traverse.words: sweeping steadily across the continent from {from} to {to}, coastlines and mountain ranges sliding past below
continent_traverse.source: the ISS crosses a continent in minutes (esa_iss); a faster pass is a time-lapse and reads as one

fpv_flip.words: flipping end over end once mid-flight and carrying straight on
fpv_flip.source: dji_avata2 Easy ACRO: front flip or backflip; unavailable below 1.5 m. Once per film: a stunt is punctuation [house rule C4: warns]

fpv_roll.words: rolling once through a full barrel roll and levelling out
fpv_roll.source: dji_avata2 Easy ACRO: one roll left or right; unavailable below 1.5 m

fpv_drift_180.words: sliding sideways through a half-turn to look back the way it came
fpv_drift_180.source: dji_avata2 Easy ACRO: 180-degree drift left or right

dji._about: What DJI's apps fly for you, from DJI's own manuals. The pilot sheet names the preset for each aerial shot, or Waypoint Flight when none fits. The app's auto-edited QuickShots and MasterShots videos never reach the cut: only the raw clips go into 03-raw. Prompts name the motion, never the preset (preset_words).

dont_use: subject blocked or out of line of sight
subject the same colour or pattern as its surroundings
large plain areas such as snow or desert (Mini 5 Pro)
darker than 300 lux or brighter than 10,000 lux
close to buildings or with weak GNSS

activetrack_m.note: Mini 4 Pro figures; the Mini 5 Pro allows people and vehicles 0.5-50 m high and vehicles 4-50 m away; the Mavic 4 Pro caps people at 20 m and vehicles at 100 m

speeds_mps.source: dji_mini4pro specifications and p27; dji_neo; dji_avata2 specifications

gimbal_tilt_deg.source: dji_mavic4pro specifications (controllable range): it can look up 60 degrees

per_point: heading (Follow Course, POI, Manual or Custom)
waypoint.curves: the route curves between waypoints, so the aircraft can dip below the waypoint altitudes: check what is under the route

dronie.motion: flies backward and ascends, camera locked on the subject
dronie.note: the Neo flies back, then forward again, and records both

rocket.motion: ascends with the camera pointing down
rocket.note: the Neo keeps the camera on the subject and can rotate on the way up

circle.set: direction (the current distance is the radius)

helix.motion: flies back and up while circling once, the radius widening
helix.note: one turn only: a longer helix is flown by hand or with Cruise Control

boomerang.motion: an oval round the subject, highest at the far end

asteroid.motion: back and up, stitches a panorama, opens on it and descends

mastershots.set: subject and flight range (width, length, height)
mastershots.motion: about ten classic moves in a row with the subject centred: zoom in/out, medium circle, close circle, dronie, far circle, tilt up and fly forward, rocket, camera down and circle, camera level and descend, camera down and descend
mastershots.note: a coverage pass, one battery, for raw: the app's edit is not used

spotlight.motion: you fly; the camera stays locked on the subject

poi.motion: circles the subject at the current height and radius, up to 12 m/s
poi.note: the long or slow orbit QuickShots cannot do; stop it at 1.5 turns

activetrack_trace.motion: follows from a set side relative to where the subject is heading

activetrack_parallel.motion: follows on a fixed compass bearing from the subject

hyperlapse.app: Hyperlapse > Free, Circle, Course Lock or Waypoint

waypoint_flight.note: fly every hole the same way, then re-fly the route in other light

easy_acro.motion: front flip, backflip, roll, 180-degree drift, slide
easy_acro.note: switch it on before recording (it cannot be enabled while recording); not below 1.5 m, below 25 % battery or in Sport mode

denied_presets.1ac7759b-7df1-4c96-a97a-baf611f7d38e: Higgsfield's Earth Zoom preset — reference only until its underlying model is confirmed on the approved roster; build the move from approved models and real seeds
